decision_semantics.legacy_survival_fields: Every *_survival Boolean is a differential threshold, not a statement that either map has or lacks absolute information.
decision_semantics.no_survival_legacy_label: NO_SURVIVAL_FOR_THIS_MAP, if emitted, means no differential gain on any endpoint and does not mean zero absolute retrieval.

decision.reason_no_global_winner: R6i and R6 trade one active qubit/Bell preparation and compiler proxy gates against postselection/coarse-graining; there is no Pareto dominance across the full vector ledger.

experiment_kind: one-shot associative retrieval; not temporal QRC

compiler_proxy.qualification: Encoder compiler proxy only; R6 common-erasure coarse graining, coupling, timing, calibration, Naimark receiver synthesis, and hardware execution are not priced.

resource_ledger.rule: vector valued; no scalar resource score

typed_remainders.statement: R6i is a point encoding with nonzero composition defect, not a finite-dimensional unitary representation.
This is finite-grid associative retrieval, not a temporal memory-capacity or asymptotic coding theorem.
The clean PGM receiver is mathematically specified but its Naimark/circuit/tomography cost is not synthesized.
Global depolarization is a basis-invariant stress channel, not a device noise model.
R6T covers only the SU(1,1)/U(1) lowest-weight orbit and is a non-competing truncation stress control.
